name: Violectric
_one_company_two_brands: Violectric and Lake People are the same firm. The Impressum on violectric.de names « Lake People electronic GmbH, Max-Stromeyer-Str. 116, 78467 Konstanz » as the provider, and lake-people.de names the same entity at the same address; both footers read « (c) 2026 cma audio GmbH. Alle Rechte vorbehalten. » Violectric is the consumer line and Lake People the professional one. They are kept as two brands only if Lake People ever gets a record - today it has none, because the one Lake People product read, the Phone-Amp G118, turned out to have analogue inputs and no converter at all.
